hook.name: NexsetsHook
hook.description: ETH fee hook for a token launch that cycles buy and sell taxes through a 1–5% repeating schedule. Applies a 60% anti-snipe tax during a 4-second post-launch window for non-whitelisted addresses, with an admin-controlled sell-only override (up to 60%). LP is permanently locked after the one-time seed. All fees route 100% to the protocol treasury.
